pages.name: Fried Liver Attack
pages.notes: needs-research: plan 2 relies on 'the pin on the e5 pawn', which does not exist; two rewrites were rejected (Qf5+ drops the queen to ...Kxf5; the second named White's knight on d5 before 11.Nxd5), so the old text is kept. Fixed: plan 1 castled a king that has already moved (now 10...Nxa1 11.Nxd5); plan 4's 'd5 pawn' is a knight. British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Fried Liver Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black play ...Ke6 before taking on f7; plan 1's 'Qf3-g3' replaced by 7.Qf3+ Ke6 and Nc3 against the pinned d5-knight. Overview explains the pin; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Traxler Counterattack, Bishop Sacrifice Line
pages.notes: Plan 1's ...Qh4 is blocked by the king on e7; rewritten around ...Rf8, ...d6 and ...Bg4. Plan 4's 'f8-rook' (it is on h8 yet) reworded; plan 3 corrected (White is a pawn up). British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Traxler Counterattack, King March Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 aimed ...Qh4 at f2 and g2 without the real threat (...Qf2 mate); plan 2 played Re1 with the king on g1 in the way. Rewritten around 7...Qh4 8.g3 Nxg3 9.hxg3 Qxg3+.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Ulvestad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Qb6 through the c7-pawn; the first rewrite's '...Bb7 adds pressure on g2' was rejected (the c6-knight blocks it) and corrected. Overview no longer calls 4.Ng5 a Fried Liver set-up; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...d5 onto White's d5-bishop; rewritten around the f-file, ...d6 and ...Bg4. Plan 4's 'c3-d4' and the overview's 'Fried Liver Attack setup' corrected; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the queen to h4 through the king on e7 and pinned a f3-knight that is on g5; rewritten around ...Bg4 hitting the d1-queen and ...Bb6. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1 used the b-file with the b6-bishop on it and wrote 'd2-d4'; rewritten. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Fritz variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed d2-d4 onto Black's d4-knight; rewritten around 7...Nxd5 8.cxd4 Qxg5. British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Fritz variation
pages.notes: Plan 1's Kg2 walk and 'material advantage' (material is level after 8...Qxg5) rewritten around covering g2 and Bxb5+.
